metadata.title: COSU Clinical / Medical Exam Room Terminal SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Clinical and Medical Exam Room Terminals as purpose-bound endpoint execution environments supporting in-room clinical workflows.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-name: COSU Clinical / Medical Exam Room Terminal
system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to clinical examination room workflows such as chart review, order entry, imaging display, and patient interaction, with shared use and strict purpose constraints.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Clinical Exam Room Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for in-room clinical workflows.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved clinical applications such as EHR viewers, order entry, imaging review, and medical device interfaces.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Clinicians authenticate individually on a shared device; no persistent local user profiles are retained.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Clinical Exam Room Terminals are owned by the institution or affiliated clinical entity.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Terminals are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and updated.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for secure communication with clinical platforms and endpoint management, not for data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables general productivity software, removable media, local storage, and non-clinical applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: Clinician sessions are isolated and cleared at logout or inactivity timeout to prevent cross-patient data exposure.

props.name: medical-peripheral-integration
props.remarks: Integration with approved medical peripherals (e.g., vitals, imaging) is permitted under controlled configurations.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved EHR systems, clinical imaging platforms, medical device interfaces, identity services, and management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Patient data must not be stored locally beyond transient, encrypted in-memory use.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Clinical Exam Room Terminals may participate in workflows involving regulated health and clinical data as governed by Secure Data and clinical policy.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Clinical examination authority does not imply eligibility for IT administration, security investigation, or DAW-level trust.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Clinical Exam Room Terminals must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support patient care.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Terminal health, authentication events, configuration drift, and tamper attempts are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Provisioning, update, reset, and retirement workflows are auditable and aligned with clinical governance requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Clinical Exam Room Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on patient privacy, session isolation, regulated data handling, and clinical availability.

roles.title: Clinical Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for clinical use, availability, and integrity of Exam Room Terminals.

roles.title: Clinical Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines authorized workflows, data handling requirements, and compliance obligations.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance of Clinical Exam Room Terminals.

control-implementation.remarks: Clinical Exam Room Terminal implementations are OS- and platform-specific and are maintained as tightly controlled, versioned baselines aligned with healthcare regulatory requirements.
